title: Analysis code for "Time of blood collection and leukocyte ratio indices: evidence from randomized examination sessions in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey"
description:
Analysis code for the manuscript Time of blood collection and leukocyte ratio indices: evidence from randomized examination sessions in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.

The code reconstructs the random assignment of NHANES III households to morning or afternoon/evening examination sessions, estimates the effect of session on leukocyte counts and ratio indices against the desirable bias from biological variation, replicates the comparison in continuous NHANES 1999-2018 and 2021-2023 by the session attended, and assesses how session standardization changes associations with mortality (NCHS public-use linked mortality files, follow-up through 2019). It includes an independent Python re-implementation of the key estimates, the analysis plan registered on the Open Science Framework (https://osf.io/x62ra) and the reference outputs.

No NHANES data are included; download_data.sh retrieves the public files from the CDC. In a check on 26 September 2026, the full pipeline run from a clean copy reproduced 1,631 numeric results exactly.
notes: Data sources: NHANES III (1988-1994), continuous NHANES 1999-2018 and 2021-2023 public-use data files (https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/) and the NCHS public-use linked mortality files with follow-up through 31 December 2019 (https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/linked-data/mortality-files/). The data are not redistributed in this archive. Their use is governed by the NCHS Data User Agreement (https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/policy/data-user-agreement.html), not by the MIT License of the code.
